from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, Literal

Category = Literal[
    "劳动争议，人事争议",
    "行政行为-行政许可",
    "继承纠纷",
    "执行案由-先予执行",
    "海事海商纠纷",
    "执行案由-民事",
    "行政行为-行政裁决",
    "渎职罪",
    "行政行为-行政处罚"
]

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its assigned case category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as provided")
    category: Optional[Category] = Field(description="The case category from the predefined 9 labels, or None if no match")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[Judgment]
